immutability.production_changes: None. Never edit candidate worktrees or existing immutable binaries/source snapshots for this proposal.
immutability.new_artifacts: Create write-once supplemental directories with manifests pointing to exact existing snapshot and patch SHA256 values. Use a separately frozen supplemental driver. Preserve v3 results and protocol unchanged.
immutability.timing_builds: New companion drivers may link the same immutable production snapshots; record compiler, resolved lock, profile, flags, allocator and driver SHA256. Force per-profile crate invalidation and verify exact compile path. Do not time instrumented allocator builds.
immutability.instrumented_builds: Exact Rust allocation-request counts require instrumentation: the library already declares Jemalloc globally, so adding a second global allocator in a consumer is invalid. Proposal is a separately archived validation copy of the same snapshot with ONLY the global-allocator declaration redirected to a counting wrapper around the same Jemalloc backend and a cfg(test)-only capacity observer. Prove all numerical/API/source bytes outside these declared instrumentation edits match the immutable snapshot. No production changes or inferred exactness if this cannot be verified. Root must approve this validation-only mechanism before implementation.

allocation_metrics.scope: One Linux thread, explicit operation boundaries, no JSON/report allocation inside the measured region. Use a fixed preallocated metrics buffer and allocation-free counters.
exact_requested_metrics: Successful Rust GlobalAlloc alloc, alloc_zeroed and realloc calls, counted separately; failed requests recorded separately
dealloc calls and requested bytes released
total requested allocation/reallocation bytes during operation
live requested bytes before operation, after return and after output destruction
maximum live requested bytes during operation and incremental peak above the pre-operation live set
input and returned centroid Vec len and actual Vec capacity in validation-only observer
allocation_metrics.realloc_accounting: On success replace old layout bytes with new layout bytes and update peak; on failure retain old live bytes. Count realloc separately from fresh alloc. Keep pointer movement as a separate observable if safely available.
allocation_metrics.usable_memory: If the pinned Jemalloc backend exposes a verified usable-size API, record actual usable allocation bytes/peak through that API as a distinct metric. Otherwise label requested-byte peak exactly and do not call it actual allocator capacity or RSS.
allocation_metrics.additional_descriptive_metrics: In a separate untimed fresh process, report Jemalloc allocated/active/resident and process VmHWM after controlled warmup. These are allocator/process measurements with caches/startup included, not exact per-operation peaks.
allocation_metrics.limitations: Rust GlobalAlloc counters exclude native code that bypasses that allocator. Arena bin nmalloc and thread allocated-byte counters are not exact Rust call counts; never relabel them as such. Existing v3 logical len-based bytes prove neither capacity nor transient peak.
allocation_metrics.capacity_gate: Returned centroid capacity must not exceed the baseline for the same operation and input. Compare retained usable bytes when available. Empty results and public-builder slack are included.
allocation_metrics.peak_gate: Any increased requested-byte or usable-byte peak is a reported storage tradeoff, preventing an unconditional no-storage-regression claim. Do not hide it behind equal wire length. No automatic retention based solely on fewer allocations.
allocation_metrics.repeat_rule: Five deterministic fresh-process untimed repeats per cell; preserve all counts. Counter instability requires investigation, not averaging away a discrepancy. Verify output exact bytes before comparing counters.

full_lifecycle_timing.ownership: Owned input reset occurs outside timed region for owned operations. A separate explicitly labeled caller-reset-inclusive arm times reset too. No kernel-only result is relabeled end-to-end.
full_lifecycle_timing.timed_owned_lifecycle: Take each already-owned input, call the public operation, black_box the result, then drop it before stopping the timer. Include outer pool container destruction consistently. Validate bytes on independently produced outputs before and after each batch, outside the clock.
full_lifecycle_timing.pool: Use identical baseline-derived pool size in both arms: min(64, max(1, floor(64MiB / measured input requested-byte footprint))). Record actual pool memory. This bounds the public-builder slack case; pool cloning must not remove slack.
full_lifecycle_timing.calibration: Same v3 baseline-only60ms target, minimum50ms retained batches, fixed CPU0, single thread, CPU lock, ABBA/BAAB schedule,2warmups/5retained batches and frozen identical repetitions. Preserve v3 threshold and instability gates. Do not tune workload or candidate after viewing confirmation.
full_lifecycle_timing.gate: A kernel gain alone is insufficient if the complete lifecycle has a reproducible regression. Instrumented allocation measurements are never used as performance timings.

other_cautions.E02: v3 fold clones the initial digest inside timing; kway clones all leaves inside timing. This is a valid reset-inclusive benchmark but the emitted caller_reset_clone_timed flag is currently false for these native operations. Label them accurately. Borrowed merge_many is not directly timed by the static owned merge_digests kway arm.
other_cautions.E20: Required sorted/random/reverse/ties/late-disorder and parallel-threshold controls are appropriate. Add a small eligibility boundary check around63/64 probes and n_centroids around n_probes before a general claim. For tied datasets, swapping final finite probes can swap equal values, so nearlysorted may remain sorted; assert actual order shape. Exact centroid hits retain binary search, so exact-hit-heavy batches need separate interpretation. RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 does not establish default multithread throughput.
other_cautions.combination: Revalidate and time retained combinations against the same baseline: E02/E03/E08 overlap merge dispatch, E05/E07/E09 overlap compression, E02/E10 overlap frontend ownership. Separate candidate wins are not additive evidence.
other_cautions.no_world_claim: All these comparisons are against the frozen modern baseline. They do not establish world-best speed or accuracy.
